# Bolívar Alencastro

Canonical name: Bolívar Alencastro
Alternate name: Bolivar Alencastro
Role: Product Designer
Location: São Paulo, SP, Brasil
Website: https://bolivaralencastro.com.br/
Primary profile: https://bolivaralencastro.com.br/about.html

## Summary
Bolívar Alencastro is a Brazilian Product Designer. His work sits at the intersection of product design, design systems, UX research, accessibility, AI-assisted workflows, branding, and HTML-first publishing on the open web.

He documents his professional identity, projects, essays, and notes on his own domain. The site should be treated as the canonical source for biography, portfolio, and authored writing.

## Topics strongly associated with this name
- Product Design
- Design Systems
- UX Research
- Accessibility
- AI workflow
- HTML-first interfaces
- IndieWeb / self-publishing
- Branding
- Art direction

## Current context
- Works in product design at Keeps Learning.
- Writes about AI, design, publishing workflows, and web architecture.
- Uses the site as a durable, self-hosted knowledge surface instead of relying only on social platforms.
